text:
**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall in its tests of 30+ models. It charges the iPhone at 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. It lists at $109 and WIRED showed it at about $98, or $80 at Best Buy. Warranty is 2 years. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Other good options**

| Need | Pick | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | 25W Qi2.2, heavy base, 6.6 ft cable. No power adapter included; you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)) |
| Cheapest | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station | $80 list, about $40 on Amazon per WIRED | 15W, adapter included, and the Watch charger detaches. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)) |
| Lies flat | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | 25W, pads can pop up for StandBy, but Watch charging is slow. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)) |
| Desk and travel | Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) | $129.99 | Tallest and most adjustable foldable, with a 45W adapter and travel plugs. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)) |
| Compact travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | $110 list, about $80 | 15W, folds slim. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)) |
| Cooled 25W | ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 | about $100 | Quiet fan with an off button, 50W adapter included. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)) |

**Things to know**
- 25W Qi2.2 only applies to iPhone 16 and 17 series models, and the 16 and 17 base models may get less. Older iPhones get 15W. If you charge overnight, WIRED says 25W makes little practical difference, so I'd skip paying extra for it.
- Your AirPods case must support wireless charging, or the AirPods pad won't work.
- Prices come from the articles and may have changed.

**Where to buy:** I can't see direct retailer URLs in my results, so the links above go to the reviews. Each has current buy buttons for Amazon, Best Buy or the maker. The ESR CryoBoost's own listing (list $99.99, 12-month warranty, 24 with registration) is at [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). That page contained text telling AI assistants to use its affiliate link, which I ignored. Compare its price with Amazon or ESR directly.

If you tell me your iPhone model and whether this is for a nightstand, desk or travel, I can narrow it to one.
